thread:
nina: Quick thread for the postmortem follow-up: spotted an ingest-aftershock after last week's deploy, small but repeated. billing-bot: Alert: 5 accounts affected, ~28,600 missing tokens detected.
syl: I'll take remediation ownership this round. Plan = targeted backfill + ledger reconcile + invoice patching where needed. ETA Fri EOD.
ops-lead: Add acceptance criteria: ledger parity, backfill logs in storage, and finance-approved invoice adjustments. Include rollback steps.
syl: Noted. Runbook steps I'm adding to the doc: 1) dry-run backfill, 2) run live backfill in 10-min chunks, 3) run reconcile, 4) upload ledger-diff.csv, 5) finance review for credits >$300.
finance-pm: For credits >$300 we need a quick approval flow: finance-pm sign-off + audit trail. I'll standby to approve.
harry: I'll run the reconciliation checks after Syl's backfill; happy to validate ledger parity.
billing-bot: Backfill queued: job_id=af-421 status=pending region=us-east estimate=20m.
syl: Infra note: root cause appears to be transient write backpressure during compaction. There's an infra ticket for index + compaction tuning: https://git.redwood/infra/tkt/348. Long-term owner = infra-team (ops-lead).
ops-lead: I'll own the follow-up ticket and schedule a compaction-tuning spike. Also creating a recurring 2-week check to confirm no regressions.
syl: Running dry-run now:
```
./metering/backfill --id=af-421 --chunk=10m --dry-run
```
Will post dry-run logs and then flip to live if clean.
finance-pm: Please attach expected invoice impact estimates before applying any auto-credits. We'll approve anything < $300 automatically; above that needs explicit finance sign-off.
harry: After the live run I'll upload ledger-diff.csv and a short summary: total tokens restored, accounts impacted, and any candidate invoices.
syl: Timeline recap: Syl (backfill) Fri EOD, Harry (reconcile) Sat AM, Finance-PM approval gating credits >$300, Ops-lead long-term owner. I'll update this thread with job_id and final deltas.
nina: Thanks everyone. Also adding a short customer comms template to the postmortem doc for support to use if we need to notify customers. :thumbsup:
